parts.text: $JPM Q3 2026: revenue $50.2B, +8% Y/Y, driven by higher net interest income from markets and deposit balances. Operating margin 40.1%; net earnings $15.3B. Operating cash flow reached $33.2B. #earnings #banks
$SMCI Q1 FY27 (preliminary): revenue $19.9B, +298% Y/Y, driven by total AI and IT datacenter solutions. Net earnings $1.6B; operating margin 10.4%. Guides Q2 revenue to $19.5B-$21.5B. #earnings #tech

$CPNG Q3 2026: revenue $10.0B, +8% Y/Y, driven by higher customer engagement despite impacts from the data incident and Incheon FC fire. Operating margin -4.5%; operating cash flow $212M. #earnings #ecommerce
$BKNG Q3 2026: revenue $8.9B, -1% Y/Y, driven by room nights up 7% as international travel improved. Operating margin 38.4%; operating cash flow $1.1B. #earnings #industrials
$XYZ Q3 2026: revenue $6.7B, +10% Y/Y, driven by 31% growth in financial solutions. Operating margin 6.4%; operating cash flow $1.0B. #earnings #software
$AES Q3 2026: revenue $3.9B, +16% Y/Y, driven by higher spot market energy sales and utility demand, with an operating margin of 13.4%. #earnings #utilities
$ANET Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.7B, up 58% Y/Y, driven by strong demand for AI networking architectures. Operating margin was 44.9% as the company posted record growth. #earnings #tech

$GXO Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.6B, +6% Y/Y, driven by fastest organic growth in over three years and record new business wins. Operating margin 2.7%. Reaffirms full-year guidance. #earnings #industrials

$AIZ Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.5B, +9% Y/Y, driven by Connected Living and Global Housing growth. Net earnings $275M; company guides to low double-digit adjusted EPS growth for the full year. #earnings #insurance

$CAR Q3 2026 (preliminary): revenue $3.4B, -2% Y/Y, as vehicle utilization reached a third-quarter record high of 74.0% amid softer travel demand. Operating margin 9.0%; net earnings $183M. #earnings #EarningsSeason
$FITB Q3 2026: revenue reached $3.3B, up 42% Y/Y following the Comerica merger, with net interest income providing 69% of total revenue. Operating margin stood at 33.8%. #earnings #banks

$APTV Q3 2026: Revenue $3.2B, +2% Y/Y, driven by volume growth in North America and Asia Pacific following the spin-off of the electrical distribution business. Operating margin 8.8%. #earnings #autos
